hints.title: Free Moving Boundary Cars
hints.text: Cars on the left moving L drive off to negative infinity without ever colliding with anything.

hints.title: Right Boundary Cars
hints.text: Cars on the right moving R drive off to positive infinity without ever colliding with anything.

hints.title: Intermediate Collision Inevitability
hints.text: Between the leftmost non-L car and rightmost non-R car, every single moving car (L or R) will eventually collide and stop.

hints.title: Trimmed Substring Non-Stationary Count

complexity.notes: Trimming and counting non-stationary cars takes linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating sequential physics steps takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space when using two-pointer index trimming.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies invariant that all bounded moving cars eventually collide.
